exercises.audioRequiredUz: Ismlar audio'dan eshitiladi. Audio bo'lmasa ham mashqning ASOSIY qismi — odamlarni tasvirlash — to'liq bajariladi (quyida har rasm tavsifi berilgan).
exercises.instructionEn: The pictures show people from the Wessex area who are missing. Look at their pictures and describe them. Listen and label them with their names from the list.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarda Wessex hududidan bedarak yo'qolgan odamlar. Rasmlarga qarab ularni tasvirlang. So'ng eshitib, ro'yxatdagi ismlarni qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
Odamni tasvirlash tartibi (shu ketma-ketlikni saqlang):
  1) YOSH   — young / middle-aged / old
  2) BO'Y-GAVDA — tall, short, slim, well-built
  3) SOCH   — uzunlik + shakl + rang
  4) KO'Z   — rang
  5) BOSHQA — beard, moustache, glasses

Namuna: 'She's young. She's got long straight black hair and green eyes.'

profiles.descEn: A young woman with long straight black hair, a white headband and green eyes.
profiles.descUz: Yosh ayol: uzun tekis qora soch, oq bosh bog'ich, yashil ko'z.
profiles.modelSentence: She's young. She's got long straight black hair and green eyes.

profiles.descEn: An old man with a white beard, a moustache and glasses.
profiles.descUz: Keksa erkak: oq soqol, mo'ylov va ko'zoynak.
profiles.modelSentence: He's old. He's got a white beard and a moustache. He wears glasses.

profiles.descEn: A young person with short fair hair and blue eyes, wearing a red top.
profiles.descUz: Yosh odam: kalta oq-sariq soch, ko'k ko'z, qizil kiyim.
profiles.modelSentence: He's young. He's got short fair hair and blue eyes.

profiles.descEn: A woman with long dark curly hair.
profiles.modelSentence: She's got long dark curly hair.

profiles.descEn: A middle-aged man with short grey hair and a moustache.
profiles.descUz: O'rta yoshli erkak: kalta kulrang soch va mo'ylov.
profiles.modelSentence: He's middle-aged. He's got short grey hair and a moustache.

exercises.instructionEn: Choose one of the people in Ex. 9 and describe him or her to your classmates. The student who guesses correctly chooses another person and the game continues.
exercises.instructionUz: Ex. 9 dagi odamlardan birini tanlab, sinfdoshlaringizga tasvirlang. To'g'ri topgan o'quvchi keyingi odamni tanlaydi va o'yin davom etadi.
exercises.explanationUz:
Bu o'yin tasvirlash so'zlarini mustahkamlaydi. Ilovada siz topuvchi bo'lasiz: tavsif beriladi, siz qaysi odam ekanini aniqlaysiz.

O'yin so'zlari — ularni gapga qo'shib ishlating:
  young / middle-aged → 'He's middle-aged.'
  curly / long / straight → 'She's got long curly hair.'
  slim / well-built → 'He's well-built.'
  beard / moustache / big nose → 'He's got a beard.'

exercises.instructionEn: Which of the pictures show someone with a pale complexion? light brown skin? very dark skin and a wide, flattish nose? dark slanting eyes and a yellowish complexion? dark brown eyes and dark skin?
exercises.instructionUz: Qaysi rasmda: oqish yuz rangi? och jigarrang teri? juda to'q teri va keng, yassiroq burun? qiyshiq qora ko'z va sarg'ish yuz rangi? to'q jigarrang ko'z va to'q teri?
exercises.explanationUz:
TERI va YUZ RANGI so'zlari:
• complexion — yuz rangi (teri emas, aynan yuzning ko'rinishi)
• pale — oqish, oqarinqiragan
• light brown skin — och jigarrang teri
• dark skin — to'q teri
• yellowish — sarg'ish (-ish qo'shimchasi 'ga moyil' degani)

BURUN va KO'Z:
• a wide, flattish nose — keng, yassiroq burun
• slanting eyes — qiyshiq (cho'ziq) ko'z

answers.descEn: Which picture shows someone with a pale complexion?
Which picture shows someone with light brown skin?
Which picture shows someone with very dark skin and a wide, flattish nose?
answers.descUz: Qaysi rasmda juda to'q teri va keng, yassiroq burun?

answers.descEn: Which picture shows someone with dark slanting eyes and a yellowish complexion?
answers.descUz: Qaysi rasmda qiyshiq qora ko'z va sarg'ish yuz rangi?

answers.descEn: Which picture shows someone with dark brown eyes and dark skin?
answers.descUz: Qaysi rasmda to'q jigarrang ko'z va to'q teri?

exercises.instructionEn: Listen and match the numbers to the pictures.
exercises.explanationUz:
Har matn bitta mintaqani tasvirlaydi. Matndagi tafsilot rasmni aniqlab beradi:
• 'fair hair, blue eyes, pale complexion' → D
• 'light brown skin' → C
• 'very dark skin, wide flattish nose' → E
• 'dark skin, dark hair' (arab mamlakatlari) → B
• 'slanting eyes, yellowish complexion' → A

answers.why: Baland bo'y, oq-sariq soch, ko'k ko'z, oqish yuz rangi
Past bo'y, qora soch, jigarrang ko'z, och jigarrang teri
Qora jingalak soch, juda to'q teri, keng yassiroq burun
Qora soch, to'q jigarrang ko'z, to'q teri
Qalin qora soch, qiyshiq ko'z, kichik burun, sarg'ish yuz rangi

exercises.instructionEn: Read the texts and answer the questions.
exercises.instructionUz: Matnlarni o'qing va savollarga javob bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
Javob qolipi: 'They are usually ... They have got ...'

DIQQAT — 'usually' (odatda) so'zi muhim: matn UMUMIY tendensiyani aytadi,
har bir odam haqida emas. Shuning uchun 'usually', 'most people', 'rather'
kabi yumshatuvchi so'zlar ishlatilgan.

Bu so'zlar tilda 'hedging' deyiladi — qat'iy da'vodan qochish.
exercises.readingNote: Matnlarni kitobingizdan o'qing (14-bet). Quyida ularning ma'lumoti va javoblar berilgan.

people.name: Mediterranean countries (Italy, Spain, Greece)

people.name: central and southern Africa

questions.en: What do people from Denmark, Norway and Sweden look like?
questions.uz: Daniya, Norvegiya va Shvetsiyaliklar qanday ko'rinishda?
questions.answerEn: They are usually tall with fair hair, blue eyes and a pale complexion.
questions.answerUz: Ular odatda baland bo'yli, oq-sariq sochli, ko'k ko'zli va oqish yuzli.

questions.en: What do people from Mediterranean countries look like?
questions.uz: O'rta yer dengizi mamlakatlari aholisi qanday ko'rinishda?
questions.answerEn: They are rather short. They have usually got black or dark brown hair, brown eyes and light brown skin.
questions.answerUz: Ular ancha past bo'yli. Odatda qora yoki to'q jigarrang sochli, jigarrang ko'zli va och jigarrang terili.

questions.en: What do people from central and southern parts of Africa look like?
questions.uz: Markaziy va janubiy Afrika aholisi qanday ko'rinishda?
questions.answerEn: They have got black curly hair and very dark skin. They have also got dark brown eyes, full lips and a wide, flattish nose.
questions.answerUz: Ularning qora jingalak sochi va juda to'q terisi bor. Shuningdek to'q jigarrang ko'z, to'la lab va keng, yassiroq burun.

questions.en: What do people from Arab countries look like?
questions.answerEn: They have usually got dark hair and dark brown eyes. They have also got dark skin.
questions.answerUz: Ularning odatda qora sochi va to'q jigarrang ko'zi bor. Shuningdek to'q terisi bor.

questions.en: What do people from northern China look like?
questions.answerEn: They are quite short, with thick black hair and dark, slanting eyes. They have got a small nose and a yellowish complexion.
questions.answerUz: Ular ancha past bo'yli, qalin qora sochli va qiyshiq qora ko'zli. Kichik burni va sarg'ish yuz rangi bor.

questions.en: What do people from your country look like?
questions.answerEn: Most people in Uzbekistan have got dark hair and brown eyes. They usually have light brown skin.
questions.answerUz: O'zbekistonda ko'pchilikning qora sochi va jigarrang ko'zi bor. Odatda terisi och jigarrang.
questions.noteUz: Bu ochiq savol — o'z javobingizni tuzing. 'usually', 'most people' so'zlarini ishlating.

groups.explanationUz:
Sifatga -ish qo'shilsa, ma'no YUMSHAYDI: to'liq emas, shunga o'xshash.
Bu juda foydali qo'shimcha — istalgan rangga qo'shsa bo'ladi.

patterns.formula: Most people in JOY + are/have got + ...
patterns.exampleEn: Most people in Mediterranean countries are rather short.
patterns.exampleUz: O'rta yer dengizi mamlakatlarida ko'pchilik ancha past bo'yli.
patterns.explanationUz: 'Most people' — ko'pchilik. Qat'iy 'all' o'rniga ishlatiladi, chunki hamma bir xil emas.

patterns.exampleEn: They have usually got dark hair.
patterns.explanationUz: 'usually' HAVE va GOT orasiga tushadi: 'have usually got'. Bu tez-tez uchraydigan holatni bildiradi.

patterns.formula: What do people from JOY look like?
patterns.exampleEn: What do people from northern China look like?
patterns.explanationUz:
'look like' — tashqi ko'rinishni so'rash. 'How do they look?' ham mumkin, lekin 'What ... look like?' odatiyroq.
DIQQAT: bu yerda 'do' ishlatiladi, chunki 'look' oddiy fe'l ('be' emas).

patterns.exampleEn: They have also got dark brown eyes and full lips.
patterns.exampleUz: Shuningdek to'q jigarrang ko'zi va to'la labi bor.
patterns.explanationUz: 'also' — shuningdek. U HAVE va GOT orasiga tushadi. Qo'shimcha ma'lumot berishda ishlatiladi.
